title: Ink Atlas
intro: Every map on this page is a PNG in a public Hugging Face dataset, and each surface's meta.json links the mesh and the CT it was rendered from; here they are for your own tools, with the page's API and MCP server.

sources.title: The atlas: every map of every surface (SharpMeow/first-letters-ink-atlas)
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (derived from Vesuvius Challenge open data and ketchupbyheinz's meshes)
sources.note: atlas.json lists every surface and its folder. Each folder holds maps/MODEL/WINDOW_s1_ORDER.png (8-bit, 0 to 1 as 0 to 255), ensemble/ and ensemble-rev/, ct_mid.png, preview.jpg and meta.json. Model output, not a reading.

sources.title: One map: the ensemble of PHerc0343 reference surface 4937_3336_11593
sources.note: 2016 x 2016 pixels at 9.6 um, the same grid as every other map of that surface, so maps stack pixel for pixel. The ensemble PNG maps z from -2 to 4 onto 0 to 255.

sources.title: The traced mesh behind that surface (tifxyz, ketchupbyheinz)
sources.note: x.tif, y.tif and z.tif in level-0 voxels of the 8.64 um PHerc0343 scan. Every surface's meta.json names its mesh in mesh.base.

sources.title: The CT that mesh is on: PHerc0343, 8.64 um
sources.note: Read live from the open-data bucket; the atlas rendered level 0. Every surface's meta.json names its CT in ct.

sources.title: Browse the atlas from code or an agent
sources.note: get_map and compare_models return pictures and records; surface_info gives every file's URL. Runs on the Space's CPU, no key. Model output, not a reading.
